title: Basic Granny Square
description: A classic crochet motif that teaches double crochet clusters and corners.
expectationText: A classic motif that teaches corners, clusters, and round structure without jumping into a huge project.

steps.title: Center ring
steps.instruction: Create a magic ring or chain 4 and join into a loop.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Make 4 granny clusters separated by chain spaces and join to close the square.

steps.title: Round 2
steps.instruction: Slip stitch to a corner space, build the next layer of granny clusters, and form corners with chain spaces.

steps.title: Round 3
steps.instruction: Repeat granny clusters along the sides and corners until the square reaches the size you want.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Join the round, fasten off, and weave in ends.
